description: Assisting with experiments involving plant abiotic stress and mitigation strategies, collaborating with team members to analyze data and prepare reports.
Participated in a Ministry-funded project on nano urea and moisture stress in Vigna radiata.
Contributed to a study on bio-intensive management and data collection and analysis of seasonal leaf miners infesting tomato plants.
Contributed to a study on organic and inorganic fertilizers and mung bean growth and yield through soil fertility, crop growth, pod collection, and fertilizer treatment data.
